summary: Iteration 4 — Verified (1) RT-scoped Feed Warga (village default, rt scope, cross-village 403, admin sees all, rt_id-outside-scope 403, like/comment 403 on out-of-area posts, empty comment 400, rt_name present) and (2) Marketplace Order Requests end-to-end on mobile 390x844 with two residents in the same ACTIVE RT (Gandaria Utara / RW 002 / RT 005). Backend 34/34 new tests pass + 59/59 previous regression tests pass. Frontend: scope toggle, feed-post-rt label, product dialog with qty stepper updating order-total, order-submit redirect to /app/pesanan, order-total-<id>, seller accept→completed with buyer status-chip-COMPLETED, buyer cancel pending, marketplace-orders-button nav, order-chat opens conversation directly, product-own-note for own product, merchant-product tile opens same dialog. Home 'Kabar Warga' section still loads. Chat/reels unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/social.py _feed_rt_ids correctly unions descendant_rt_ids (RT heads/admins) with viewer's own RT + all RTs in same village when scope=village; platform admin bypasses filter. _post_or_403 permits author's own posts regardless of scope — matches 'plus their own posts' requirement. Clean implementation.

backend/routers/orders.py — all server-side validation is enforced: price/subtotal/total computed from DB, PENDING default, SELLER_MOVES/BUYER_MOVES whitelists are strict, notifications fired to the other party on both ORDER_NEW and ORDER_STATUS. Pydantic Field(ge=1, le=99) correctly yields 422 for qty 0 and 100.

Minor: in orders.py the PUT product endpoint requires full ProductReq body (no PATCH), so toggling 'available' from a 3rd-party tool needs the whole payload — fine for current UI but worth a future PATCH endpoint.

Marketplace product list filters out unavailable items at the backend, so a buyer cannot normally reach product-soldout dialog from the search tab unless they come via a saved/merchant-detail path. Not a bug but limits coverage of product-soldout UI.
Chat location.state.open consume+clear (LOW nit from iter-3) remains unfixed; still not blocking happy path.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical acceptance criteria for feed scope + orders flow
